description: Get a disclosed HelmSwap quote and a short-lived quote ticket. Fees are disclosed in each quote. An optional payout address attributes a share of that fee; the trader pays the same fee with or without it. Helm never signs or broadcasts; the user signs in their own wallet. Live: 8453 (Base), 56 (BNB Chain), 1 (Ethereum), 4663 (Robinhood Chain), 57073 (Ink), 999 (HyperEVM), 99901 (Elysium), 5042 (Arc), or chain='solana'. Arbitrum (42161) and Polygon (137) can quote but cannot build. Tokenized stocks return an error (HTTP 451) and must not be retried. US users can use this swap API. Predictions and perps are not live and are not exposed here.

amountIn.description: Integer amount in tokenIn base units (e.g. 10000000 for 0.01 SOL, 9 decimals)

chain.description: solana, base, bnb, ethereum, robinhood, or a numeric chainId

chainId.description: EVM chain id. Ignored when chain is solana. Default 8453.

referrer.description: Optional payout address (EVM 0x or Solana base58). Overrides HELM_REFERRER for this call. The share is disclosed on the quote.

tokenIn.description: Token address or native symbol (ETH, BNB, POL, SOL)

tokenOut.description: Token address or mint, or a native symbol

name: get_quote
